background: OSB Group is a UK specialist lender formed from OneSavings Bank and Charter Court, funded by retail savings under the Kent Reliance and Charter Savings brands and lending mainly on buy-to-let and professional-landlord mortgages.
synthesis: Two of the three main agencies rate the group, at BBB on average and both on a stable outlook, with the last move a one-notch upgrade by one of the three on 16 May 2023: investment-grade holding-company grades. Capital is mixed against UK mid-sized banks: CET1 of 15.2% is above the peer median, while leverage of 7.1% is a little under it, and both have fallen since 30 Jun 2025, CET1 by 0.5 points and leverage by 0.4 points. Liquidity is strong, with LCR of 172% level with the median and NSFR of 140% above it. The one flagged item, on 7 Aug 2026, is a guidance cut on higher funding costs, an earnings matter rather than a solvency one.
